main_measure.name: mean excess 20-bar forward return of active cases (forecast > 0) over coin holding mean
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 (and slope > 0); reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess 20-bar return on forecast, active cases

decided_by: The main t lies between -2 and 2 (or is undefined), which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Holding is each coin's mean 20-bar return over the same non-overlapping grid samples of all its windows; a grid bar counts only if t+20 lies in the same window; the plan's 'fewer than 30 active cases' minimum is treated as not observable; the situation is checked on regime == 'trending' plus the recorded ma_slope raw value > 0.
